text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to set up a training schedule, I 
asked Daiichi Ruby about her upcoming 
plans, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, attend a party on a cruise 
ship. The next day, a hotel meeting 
followed by dinner at a traditional 
restaurant—"
choice_data_list:
Looks like we'll have more chances to eat 
together.

Looks like we'll have more opportunities 
to eat together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is there a problem with that?
choice_data_list:
Make sure you eat lots of delicious food 
while you're there!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I am well aware. After all, my 
utmost mission is to deliver results in 
races.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
――My Lady. May I go fetch something for 
you to eat?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I make a point of refraining from eating 
and drinking just enough so as not to seem 
rude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as promised, Daiichi Ruby kept her 
calorie intake in check.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Dining together is an important part of 
negotiations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of my own wishes, I will finish 
whatever is served so as not to be rude. 
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Today's talk was very fascinating. I also 
thoroughly enjoyed the meal—

text_block_list.name: Dinner Companion
text_block_list.text:
Then, please be sure to enjoy the dessert 
buffet at the end. Our chef has prepared 
it in another room.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I will gladly 
partake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daiichi Ruby finished every single 
bite of the massive feast without leaving 
anything behind.
